claims: Michigan defeated UConn 69-63 in the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball National Championship game.
The 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball National Championship game was on April 6, 2026.
Michigan won their first title since 1989.
Elliot Cadeau was the Most Outstanding Player.
The game was at Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis, IN.
Michigan became the first team to beat UConn in the Sweet 16 or later since 2009.
Michigan shot 0-for-8 from 3-point range in the first half.
Freshman Trey McKenney sealed the game with two free throws with 13 seconds remaining.
Dusty May is the head coach of the Wolverines.
